rare_knowledge.instructions: Does answering this request well require rare, specialized or obscure factual knowledge (niche facts, specific names, dates, technical details) that a small language model is likely not to know?

criteria.true: rare or specialized knowledge is needed
criteria.false: common knowledge or no factual knowledge is enough

multistep.instructions: Does answering this request require multi-step reasoning or calculation, where several intermediate steps must all be correct?

criteria.true: several dependent reasoning or calculation steps are needed
criteria.false: the answer follows directly in one step

code.instructions: Does answering this request require writing, fixing or explaining non-trivial program code?

criteria.true: non-trivial code must be written, fixed or explained
criteria.false: no code, or only a trivial snippet

long_answer.instructions: Does a good answer to this request need to be long (more than about 300 words or a longer piece of code)?

single_correct.instructions: Does this request have a single verifiable correct answer (a fact, a number, or code that must pass tests)?

criteria.true: there is one verifiable correct answer
criteria.false: many different answers can be acceptable

open_ended.instructions: Is this an open-ended request (creative writing, opinion, casual conversation) where many different answers are good?

constraints.instructions: Does this request contain many explicit requirements the answer must satisfy (format, length, style, conditions)?

criteria.true: several explicit requirements must be satisfied

small_model_enough.instructions: Would a small assistant model (about 8 billion parameters) answer this request as well as a large, strong model?

criteria.true: a small model would answer it as well
criteria.false: a large model would answer it clearly better
